release_notes: Build 121 removes the white Windows icon gutter from the Library More dropdown.
The More menu now uses Factburst-only ContextMenu, MenuItem and separator templates with a continuous dark background and cyan border.
Hover, disabled and destructive menu states remain visually distinct without falling back to default Windows chrome.
A regression check protects the custom menu chrome so the white gutter cannot silently return.
Build 120 Publication State header contrast and More button outline improvements remain included unchanged.
